0022600131.text: The Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 1st in the West) host the Portland Trail Blazers (2-0) in their fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Los Angeles on a three-game winning streak and 2-0 at home. Los Angeles is without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain), while Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery) and has Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Lakers lost the series 1-2, including a 132-116 loss in Portland on January 17, 2026.
